source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Maintaining the drainage system at the height specified by the provider, since incorrect positioning can cause over- or under-drainage of CSF","B":"Allowing the drainage system to be positioned at essentially any height, without much specific consideration given to CSF pressure","C":"Removing the drain independently without first obtaining a provider order to do so","D":"Requiring fairly little specific monitoring at all despite the significant risks this particular device carries"}}
source_row.rationale: Lumbar drain care requires maintaining the drainage system at the specific height specified by the provider, since incorrect positioning can cause over-drainage (risking complications like headache or herniation) or under-drainage (failing to achieve the therapeutic goal), a critical nursing responsibility for this device.
source_row.source_detail: Importance of Proper Drain Height Positioning
